annotations.title: Fixed costs on issue, judgment and enforcement (CPR 45 Section II)

description: Works out the fixed costs CPR 45 Section II allows a legal representative in England and Wales, line by line with the PD 45 table for each sum: fixed commencement costs on a money or goods claim (Table 2), judgment in default, on admission, summary judgment and Consumer Credit Act goods judgments (Table 3), possession and demotion claims (Tables 4 and 5), accelerated possession, extra service (Table 6) and enforcement (Table 7: charging orders, third party debt orders, writs, warrants, questioning, attachment of earnings). Online civil money claims follow PD 51R. No VAT and no London weighting; court fees are on top; the court can order otherwise. It never works out fixed recoverable costs (Part 45 Sections IV to X).

acceleratedUndefended.description: "accelerated": a possession order was made and the defendant did not defend.

altService.description: Table 6: service by an alternative method or at an alternative place (CPR 6.15), number of individuals served: a whole number, e.g. "1".

amount.description: "money": the amount claimed on the claim form; "goods": the value of the goods stated, in pounds, e.g. "12500" or "12,500.50".

aoeAttendances.description: Table 7: attendances at an attachment of earnings hearing: a whole number, e.g. "1".

awardOutstanding.description: Table 7: the amount outstanding under an award enforced as if payable under a court order (CPR 70.5(4)), in pounds, e.g. "12500" or "12,500.50".

cjja.description: Table 7: registering a certificate under Schedule 6 to the Civil Jurisdiction and Judgments Act 1982.

claim.description: The kind of claim: "money" (a claim for a specified sum of money), "goods" (a claim for delivery of goods), "possession" (possession of land, a demotion claim, or a Welsh prohibited conduct claim), "accelerated" (accelerated possession), "enforcement" (enforcement only), "unspecified" (unspecified damages), "hmrc" (a claim by an HMRC officer in the County Court).

extraDefendants.description: Further defendants personally served by the claimant at separate addresses: a whole number, e.g. "1".

goodsValueStated.description: "goods": a value for the goods was stated on the claim form (default true).

judgment.description: The judgment sum, if different from the amount claimed: debt and interest, without court fees and costs, in pounds, e.g. "12500" or "12,500.50".

landJudgment.description: "possession" with landStep "judgment": the kind of order: "arrears" (rent arrears claim with a fixed hearing date, not defended), "demotion" (a successful demotion or prohibited conduct claim), "other" (something else: defended, or on other grounds).

landStep.description: "possession": where the claim has got to: "issue" (issued), "gave-up" (possession given up, arrears paid), "judgment" (possession order made).

moneyInCourtRecovered.description: Table 7: amount recovered by payment out of money in court (CPR 72.10(1)(b)), in pounds, e.g. "12500" or "12,500.50".

noFixedCostsOnClaimForm.description: The claim form did not claim fixed commencement costs.

opr.description: "possession": the claim is in the Online Procedure Rules digital service.

personalDocs.description: Table 6: other documents required to be served personally, number of individuals served: a whole number, e.g. "1".

possessionPermissionPersons.description: Table 7: permission to enforce a possession order (CPR 83.13), persons given notice: a whole number, e.g. "1".

questioningMinutes.description: Table 7: minutes of questioning a judgment debtor before a court officer: a whole number, e.g. "1".

represented.description: Whether the party claiming the costs has a solicitor or other legal representative: "yes", or "no" (acting in person).

route.description: How it was issued (default paper): "paper" (on paper or Money Claim Online), "ocmc" (online civil money claims, PD 51R).

servedAbroad.description: Table 6: services out of the jurisdiction anywhere else: a whole number, e.g. "1".

servedScotlandEtc.description: Table 6: services out of the jurisdiction in Scotland, Northern Ireland, the Isle of Man or the Channel Islands: a whole number, e.g. "1".

service.description: How the claim form was served: "court" (by the court, or otherwise), "personal" (personally, by the claimant).

step.description: "money" or "goods": where the claim has got to: "issue" (issued, nothing more yet), "paid" (the defendant paid in time, with the fixed costs), "default-ack" (default judgment, no acknowledgment of service), "default-defence" (default judgment, no defence), "admission-accepted" (judgment on admission, payment proposal accepted), "admission-court" (judgment on admission, the court decided payment), "summary" (summary judgment, or defence struck out, on application), "cca" (goods only: judgment for delivery under a Consumer Credit Act regulated agreement), "small-claims" (decided on the small claims track).

tpdoRecovered.description: Table 7: amount recovered under a final third party debt order, in pounds, e.g. "12500" or "12,500.50".

warrants.description: Table 7: requests for a warrant of control or delivery, for a sum over £25: a whole number, e.g. "1".

writs.description: Table 7: writs of control or execution issued: a whole number, e.g. "1".
